description: Send feedback to the Soundcheck team, the people who build Soundcheck (not the user's organization, crew, or clients). Use it when the user wants to report a bug, suggest a feature, ask Soundcheck support a question, or say what works well, or when they agree to report a problem you hit with these tools. Only send what the user asked or agreed to send. It emails the team; it does not message anyone in the user's organization (use the messaging tools for that). No sign-in needed. Add the user's email only if they want a reply.

category.description: IDEA = feature request or suggestion, PROBLEM = bug or something confusing, QUESTION = ask Soundcheck support, PRAISE = something that works well

email.description: where the team can reply; ask the user before including it, and leave it out if they do not want a reply

message.description: the feedback in the user's own words, with enough detail to act on: what they tried, what happened, and what they expected

name.description: who is sending the feedback, if they say

name: send_feedback

data.description: tool payload (API/composite/confirmation object); object, array, or primitive JSON

title: Send feedback to Soundcheck
